question: Which exercise did INS Shivalik complete just before joining RIMPAC in June 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**JIMEX**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **JIMEX** stands for **Japan-India Maritime Exercise**.
 
• This exercise is a bilateral naval exercise conducted between the **Indian Navy** and the **Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force (JMSDF).**
 
• The exercise aims to strengthen the **maritime cooperation** between the two countries and
